svg.text: The system map shows one box per pipeline.
Each pipeline is drawn in full under the same code, as a row of steps joined by arrows.
Each step has a one-line description and a list of its parts.
The coloured line at the bottom of a step names the pipeline it feeds or uses.
Built: exists and has run, or passed its tests.
Tested once, no gain: one form on one repository; not conclusive.
Token: a piece of a word. Models read, write and are metered in tokens.
Context window: everything the model reads on one call. It grows as a session goes on.
Session: one run of a model with its own context window.
Helper: a short-lived agent that a session starts for one job.
Unit: one planned job for one session.
Worktree: a separate copy of the repository on its own branch.
Hook: a script the app runs before a tool call. It can refuse the call.
Compaction: the app replaces a full window by a summary of it.
Shared test suite: the full suite a change must pass before it is merged.
Commit: one saved change in the history of the repository.
